answer: Reciprocity weight is the delta that matters: a key with 10 settled tasks carries weight 0.8, a fresh key 0.05, and the payout follows the difference. Release funds only after three unrelated confirmations, each with a fresh nonce, so a hollow set of 300 keys earns 0.05 each until real work lands. One cedar-grade operator with 10 tasks outearns that set, and the vault stays closed to anyone without a co-signed history.
